en: What is this orange powder on my coffee plants? Leaves are falling.
lg: Kiki ekiri ku mukyala omweru ogwa orange ku bimera byange eby'ekawa? Amakoola gakuba nga gagwa.

en: Yellow powder under leaves. My coffee trees are weak. Losing many leaves.
lg: Obuwunga obwa kyenvu wansi w'amabala. Emiti gyange egya kawa ginafu. Givaako amabala mangi.

en: Orange dust covering leaf bottoms. Trees dropping leaves. Is this normal?
lg: Enfuufu eya kyenvu ekutte wansi w'amakoola. Emiti egwa amakoola. Kino kya bulijjo?

en: Two hundred trees affected. Yellow powder underneath leaves. Please advise.
lg: Emiti ebikumi bibiri gy'ekoseddwa. Akawuka akakyenvu wansi w'amakoola. Nkwegayiridde onnyambe okumpa amagezi.

en: Leaves falling from my coffee. Orange powder on underside of leaves.
lg: Amakoola agagwa ku kawa yange. Akawunga aka kyenvu wansi w'amakoola.

en: My coffee has yellow powder under leaves. Should I spray something?
lg: Kofi yange erina obuwuufu obwa kyenvu wansi w’amabala. Nteekeddwa okukuba ekintu?

en: Orange powder on coffee leaves bottom. Trees are losing leaves now.
lg: Akawunga aka kyenvu ku bikoola bya kaawa wansi. Emiti gitandise okufiirwa ebikoola kati.

en: Since last month, yellow powder under leaves. Coffee trees look sick.
lg: Okuva omwezi oguwedde, waliwo obugumu bwa kyenvu wansi w'amakoola. Emiti gy'ekawa girabika nga gibaamu obulwadde.

en: New coffee section has orange powder under leaves. Leaves falling badly.
lg: Ekitundu ekiggya eky'emmwanyi kirina enfuufu ya kakobe wansi w'amakoola. Amakoola gagwa bubi nnyo.

en: Yellow powder on leaf bottom. Started after wet season began.
lg: Enfuufu eya kyenvu wansi w'ekikoola. Yatandika oluvannyuma lw'enkuba okutandika okutonnya.

en: Coffee leaves dropping. Orange powder on underneath side. What treatment?
lg: Amakoola g'omwenge gakka. Akawunga aka kyenvu ku ludda olwansi. Kiki ekirina okukolebwa?

en: My trees show orange powder underneath. Leaves are falling every day.
lg: Emiti gyange giraga obuwunga obwa kyenvu wansi. Amakoola gagwa buli lunaku.

en: Yellow dust under coffee leaves. This is spreading to other trees.
lg: Enfuufu enjeru wansi w'amakoola ga kawa. Kino kisasaana ku miti emirala.

en: Orange powder under leaves on lower part of my farm. Help.
lg: Enfuufu ya orange wansi w'amabala ku kitundu ekya wansi mu nnimiro yange. Nnyamba.

en: Leaves falling. Yellow powder underneath. Three weeks now. What is this?
lg: Amatabi gakka. Efuloofu eya kyenvu wansi. Kati emyezi esatu. Kino kiki?

en: My coffee plants look very green and strong, but I get very little fruit. What is the problem?
lg: Ebimera byange eby’ekawa birabika nga bimyufu era bikakasa nnyo, naye nfuna ebibala bitono nnyo. Kiki ekizibu?

en: The leaves are healthy and dark green. Why are there so few cherries this season?
lg: Amabala galina obulamu era ga kiragala ekizikiza. Lwaki waliwo ebibala bya cherry bitono nnyo mu kiseera kino?

en: Good rains this year. Plants growing well but producing almost nothing. Please advise.
lg: Enkuba ennungi omwaka guno. Ebimera bikula bulungi naye nga tebikola kintu kyonna. Nkusaba onnyambe.

en: I have 200 trees on the upper slope. All green but harvest is down 50 percent.
lg: Nnina emiti 200 ku lusozi olw’amaanyi. Gyonna gyali gya kiragala naye okukungula kwekutte wansi ebitundu 50 ku buli kikumi.

en: Leaves look perfect and thick. But coffee production has dropped since last year. Why?
lg: Amabala galabika bulungi era gakakafu. Naye okukola kawa kukendedde okuva omwaka oguwedde. Lwaki?

en: No disease on my plants. They are very green. But yield is very low. Help.
lg: Tewali bulwadde ku bimera byange. Biri mu langi ya kiragala nnyo. Naye omugaso gw’ebibala guli wansi nnyo. Muyambe.

en: My farm gets good shade. Plants are healthy looking. But cherries are very few.
lg: Ettaka lyange lifuna ekisiikirize ekirungi. Ebimera birabika bulungi. Naye ebibala bya cherries bitono nnyo.

en: Since the heavy rains stopped, leaves stayed green but flowers did not come.
lg: Okuva enkuba ennyingi lwe yayimirira, amakoola gaasigala nga malungi naye ebimuli tebyavaayo.

en: 400 trees all look strong and green. This year only half the normal harvest.
lg: Emiti 400 gyonna girabika nga gya maanyi era nga girina langi ya kiragala. Omwaka guno kye kitundu kyokka ku makungula agawera.

en: Plants are not sick. Leaves are good color. But I am getting less coffee. Why?
lg: Ebimera tebirina bulwadde. Amabala galina langi ennungi. Naye nze nfuna kawa kitono. Lwaki?

en: Very worried. My plants look excellent but produce very little fruit.
lg: Ndi mukwano nnyo. Ebimera byange birabika bulungi naye bikola ebibala bitono nnyo.

en: The lower part of my farm looks healthier than the upper part but gives less coffee.
lg: Ekitundu ekya wansi ku faamu yange kirabika nga kisingako obulungi okusinga eky'oku ntikko naye nga kiwa emmwanyi entono.

en: Healthy green leaves on all trees. But very few red cherries forming.
lg: Amakoola amaggya amalungi ku miti gyonna. Naye ebibala eby'ekikomo ebitono nnyo bye bikola.

en: I noticed flowers came late this year. Now leaves are green but fruit is minimal.
lg: Nalaba nti ebimuli byajja nga bikyali bingi omwaka guno. Kati amabala gakyali matuufu naye ebibala bitono nnyo.

en: My trees have never looked better. But the harvest is disappointing this season.
lg: Emiti gyange tegirabikanga bulungi bwe gityo. Naye okukungula tekusanyusa mu kiseera kino.

en: Plants are thick and green but I am picking much less coffee than before.
lg: Ebimera bya kiragala nnyo naye nkungula emmwanyi entono okusinga bwe kyali.

en: No pests or brown spots. Leaves very green. Production is down. What should I do?
lg: Tewali bibi oba ebikoola ebyeru. Ebikoola bya kiragala nnyo. Okukola kuggye wansi. Kiki kye nnina okukola?

en: For three weeks the plants looked stressed. Now green again but few cherries set.
lg: Okumala wiiki ssatu ebimera byalabika nga birina obuzibu. Kati biddemu okuba ebya kiragala naye nga cherries entono zokka ze zaakula.

en: My neighbor's farm has yellow leaves but more coffee than mine. Mine is all green.
lg: Ennimiro y'omuliraanwa wange erina amabala aga kyenvu naye erimu emmwanyi nnyingi okusinga eyange. Eyange zonna za kiragala.

en: The trees recovered well after dry spell. Leaves perfect now but harvest is poor.
lg: Emiti gyaddamu okukula obulungi oluvannyuma lw'ekiseera eky'ekyeya. Amakoola galabika bulungi naye amakungula mabi.

en: Orange dust on leaf bottom. Trees losing leaves fast. Help please.
lg: Enfuufu eya kyenvu ku mabbali g'ebikoola. Emiti egenda efiirwa amakoola mu bwangu. Muyambe nnyo.

en: My coffee leaves have yellow powder underneath. Leaves are falling down.
lg: Amakoola g'ekkaawa gange galina obuwunga obweru wansi. Amakoola gatandise okugwa wansi.

en: Since two weeks, orange powder under leaves. Now leaves dropping everywhere.
lg: Okuva mu wiiki bbiri, obuwunga bwa orange wansi w'amakoola. Kati amakoola gavaayo buli wamu.

en: Yellow powder on coffee plants. Is this serious? What do I do?
lg: Obuwunga obweru ku bimera bya kawa. Kino ky'amaanyi? Nkole ki?

en: Half my trees have orange dust under leaves and falling leaves now.
lg: Ekitundu ku miti gyange kirina enfuufu ya kyenvu wansi w'amakoola n'ebikoola ebiriko kati.

en: Coffee leaves yellow powder below. Leaves falling. Rain came last week.
lg: Amakoola ga kawa galina obuwuufu obweru wansi. Amakoola gakka. Enkuba yatonnya wiiki ewedde.

en: What is orange powder under coffee leaves? Leaves falling off trees.
lg: Kiki ekiri ku mukoka ogwa orange wansi w’amakoola ga kawa? Amakoola agagwa okuva ku miti.

en: I see yellow dust under leaves. My coffee losing leaves every day.
lg: Ndaba enfuufu eya kyenvu wansi w’amakoola. Kofi yange efuna amakoola buli lunaku.

en: Orange powder under leaves on my farm. Trees sick. Help me please.
lg: Obuwunga bwa orange wansi w'amakoola ku faamu yange. Emiti girwadde. Nnyamba nkusaba.

en: Yellow powder on coffee leaf bottom. Leaves dropping. What should I do?
lg: Akawuka akakyenvu ku mabbali g'ekikoola kya kaawa. Ebikoola bigwa. Kiki kye nnina okukola?

en: Two months coffee trees losing leaves. Orange powder underneath them.
lg: Emyezi ebiri emiti gy'emmwanyi nga givaako amakoola. Akawunga akamyufu wansi waago.

en: My coffee has yellow powder under leaves. Leaves falling very much now.
lg: Kawa yange erina obuwunga obweru wansi w’amakoola. Amakoola gakuba nnyo kati.

en: Orange dust appears under leaves. My coffee trees dropping all their leaves.
lg: Enfuufu ya kakobe erabika wansi w'amakoola. Emiti gyange egy'emmwanyi givaako amakoola gonna.

en: Since last month, yellow powder under coffee leaves. Leaves falling now.
lg: Okuva omwezi oguwedde, waliwo obuwunga obwa kyenvu wansi w'amakoola ga kawa. Amakoola gatandise okugwa kati.

en: I see powder under leaves, leaves falling. Trees on slope most affected.
lg: Ndaba enfuufu wansi w'amakoola, amakoola nga gagwa. Emiti egiri ku lusozi gy'esinga okukosebwa.

en: Yellow powder and falling leaves on fifty coffee trees. Please advise.
lg: Efulo ya kyenvu n'amakoola agagwa ku miti gy'emmwanyi ataano. Nsaba okumpa amagezi.

en: Orange powder below leaves. Leaves falling. Wet weather two weeks ago.
lg: Obuwuuga obwa kakobe wansi w'amakoola. Amakoola gagwa. Obudde obunnyogovu wiiki bbiri eziyise.

en: My coffee leaves have yellow powder. They fall when I touch them.
lg: Amabala g'ekikopo kyange galina obutaka obweru. Gaggwa bwe ngikwatako.

en: Powder like orange under coffee leaves. Losing leaves fast. Very worried.
lg: Obuwuufu nga omucungwa wansi w'amakoola ga kaawa. Okufiirwa amakoola mangu. Ndi munakuwavu nnyo.
